episodes.title: Sky
episodes.summary: Bullies ruthlessly torment Sky at school. When his attempt at revenge backfires, Nanno intervenes and shifts the balance of power.

episodes.title: Panty
episodes.summary: Nanno joins a girls' volleyball team that is targeted by voyeurs. When the school fails to act, she pushes her teammates to protect themselves.

episodes.title: Hater
episodes.summary: Jealous of a classmate's online fame, a student launches a viral takedown. But his scheme quickly spirals when Nanno hits back with an opposing hashtag.

episodes.title: Only Nanno
episodes.summary: An influencer's bold self-image sparks a rivalry with Nanno. As the showdown escalates, the cost of pleasing a demanding fandom unveils a dark reality.

episodes.title: Corrupt Lies
episodes.summary: A school begins to crumble under the weight of corruption and neglect. As fear and scandal take hold, Nanno gains leverage over the unfolding crisis.

episodes.title: Election
episodes.summary: One student's principled campaign falters against Nanno's crowd-pleasing tactics, leaving him to question if ideals are really worth more than victory.
